minimal_identifiability.feasible: The public split decoder permits an exact finite-change bookkeeping decomposition into masked Hash-latent H versus ALL Identity107 conditions C, with the same frozen weights and physical corner P1 operator.
minimal_identifiability.not_identifiable: This alone cannot isolate original BC bits/local13 from smooth original features, Euclidean5, query32 and their nonlinear interactions inside C. It cannot establish which path caused a GT error or identify physical spatial frequency.
minimal_identifiability.coordinate_warning: Moving xyz through the original whole field changes both Hash encoding and query/coordinate-derived condition channels. Such a whole-field coordinate difference is not a pure Hash response.
minimal_identifiability.OOD_warning: H from one actual corner paired with C from another is an off-manifold counterfactual. A corner0 anchor avoids a fabricated mean/midpoint, but does not make exchanged conditions physically realizable.
minimal_identifiability.precision_warning: The existing fixed-TRAIN source-u final-output FP16 oracle gives about2–3% P1 error; that does not exclude FP16 condition-input rounding, intermediate activation arithmetic or nonlinear amplification in the native Network.

one_low_cost_candidate.scope: If selected later: one predeclared TRAIN CAD10_58, one frozen new full12 u-selected checkpoint, at most1024 original TETRA corner sets. Existing canonical geometry/BC/local/Euclidean inputs only; no new validation/dia/finaltest labels or fresh normalizer. The existing three-known-load9-basis is shared across all readouts.
one_low_cost_candidate.witness: Select at most512 cells with a corner BC-bit change, then fill to1024 from other cells, uniform without replacement within each input-only stratum with one fixed seed. If the stratum is smaller, include it all and report counts. No prediction/error-based selection, redraw, extra radius or local-channel threshold. Report stratum counts/inclusion rates; this is a bounded input-stratified diagnostic, not an unweighted whole-CAD estimate.
one_low_cost_candidate.input_only_descriptors: On the same corner differences, record BC bit-change indicators, local13 subblock changes and smooth/query condition changes separately. These are co-occurrence witnesses, not extra model ablations or a causal attribution.
one_low_cost_candidate.prepare_once: Compute fixed CAD geometry tokens/global32 and real-corner query32, actual maskedH24 and actualC107 once. Reuse this single preparation for four counterfactual Network batches, each returning9 basis values. No three-load repeated geometry/model inference.
one_low_cost_candidate.anchor: For each tetra, corner0 supplies H0,C0. For cornerk use actualHk,Ck. Native input for every variant always appends the same13 ones.
one_low_cost_candidate.acceptance: F11 must reproduce the original frozen response_basis output at those exact real corners before interpreting hybrid outputs. Use source methods/public Encoding/Network interfaces, never guess flat-buffer offsets.

symmetric_two_path.interaction: I=F11-F10-F01+F00; retain its signed values/norm and both directed path effects. Symmetric allocation shares interaction rather than making the paths independent.

one_low_cost_candidate.physical_P1: Decode the same9 values with the already-fixed common linear u scale and zero center, then select/combine the existing alpha for ver/hor/tor without additional network calls. Apply frozen cell_tensor_strain to per-cell corner delta_H/delta_C in physical mm. The per-cell corner0 baseline is constant, hence its P1 is zero; predicted cell tensor equals tensor_H+tensor_C within numeric tolerance.
one_low_cost_candidate.energy_bookkeeping: For each known load, physical-volume-weighted sampled CELL Frobenius energy has E_pred=E_H+E_C+2*<H,C>; retain signed cross and closure. There is no claim that positive diagonal energies alone are contributions adding to100%. Do not call sampled-cell results full-node P1 accuracy or a coherent globally corrected nodal field.
one_low_cost_candidate.GT_error_boundary: Without a reference this is prediction-variation bookkeeping only. If root separately allows the existing same-TRAIN selected-cell corner-P1 references, epsilon_error=epsilon_H+epsilon_C-epsilon_ref, so retain all three diagonal terms and all three signed cross terms including reference. Even then it is an algebraic description, not causal error attribution, a corrected method, or new population generalization.
one_low_cost_candidate.cost: One1024-cell/4096-corner preparation plus four small Network batches returning9 basis values; preferably one root-scheduled CUDA no-grad process. An input-only CPU roughness check is possible without a model, but cannot attribute predicted P1. No measured runtime or GPU allocation is claimed now.
one_low_cost_candidate.readout: Report physical sample-cell tensor RMS/path cross/interaction and input witness counts; a large C response supports condition-path sensitivity, not specifically BC/local causality. A large H response supports Hash-latent sensitivity, not frequency causality. Mixed/canceling terms may leave the distinction inconclusive.

limitations: Fixed seen-TRAIN geometry and frozen development-selected weights, not a random validation cohort or final-test result.
Nonlinear interactions and conventional symmetric path allocation remain; Hash and C are physically correlated.
Native mixed precision remains in every four-recipe comparison; final-u oracle is not a bound on all intermediate numeric errors.
Cell-specific anchors/stratified cells do not define a new global displacement field or full-node recovery error population.
No threshold-based candidate selection, causal claim, significance, further channel removal, architecture change or new training follows automatically.
